BiblicalUsage: Mikri is named once, in the register of the families who lived in Jerusalem after the return. Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Mikri, is counted among the Benjamites who settled the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in the register is honour enough: Mikri's grandson came home to Jerusalem, and the record kept his father's name with him.
